policy: One canonical spec per strategy, no grid, no tuning after performance. OOS and FWD are computed only for strategies passing the IS gate.

PRE_CL.role: pre-launch holdout on CL prices with MCL economics; always computed, informative, not part of the gate

OOS.role: verdict, read only for IS-gate passers

FWD.role: extension, read only for IS-gate passers

execution.roll_adjustment: additive back-adjustment at each instrument_id change (last close of old contract vs first open of new)

eia.holiday_weeks: skipped (release shifted when a US federal holiday falls Mon-Wed)

s1_trend_sma_pullback.page_rule: 50/200 SMA cross regime, enter on pullback to the 50 SMA, exit on close beyond the 50 SMA or MACD bearish cross
s1_trend_sma_pullback.entry: regime (SMA50 vs SMA200) and 15m bar touches SMA50 and closes back on the trend side
s1_trend_sma_pullback.exit: 15m close beyond SMA50 against the trade, or MACD/signal cross against the trade

s2_vwap_rsi_pullback.page_rule: after the US open, clean break and hold above VWAP with RSI > 50, enter on first pullback to VWAP, stop 1x ATR, target 2:1
s2_vwap_rsi_pullback.break_and_hold: 15m close crosses VWAP, next 15m close stays beyond it
s2_vwap_rsi_pullback.entry: limit at VWAP, cancelled on a 15m close back through VWAP

s3_breakout_retest.page_rule: close beyond horizontal S/R on higher-than-average volume, do not enter the breakout candle, enter the retest
s3_breakout_retest.transposition: daily close through S/R -> 15m close through prior trading-day high/low
s3_breakout_retest.entry: limit at the broken level, cancelled on a 15m close back through it
s3_breakout_retest.omitted: Bollinger compression (descriptive on the page, not a rule)

s4_range_rsi_bb_reversion.page_rule: RSI < 30 at support / > 70 at resistance with Bollinger extremes, tight stop outside the range, avoid trending markets
s4_range_rsi_bb_reversion.range_filter: abs(SMA50 - SMA200) <= 1.0 x ATR14 on 15m bars
s4_range_rsi_bb_reversion.entry: 15m close outside the band with RSI extreme

s5_eia_post_event_trend.page_rule: wait for the initial EIA spike to exhaust, then enter in the direction of the prevailing trend
